text: 41 Opposites 3.1 You say yes and I say no, You say stop and I say go, You say fast and I say slow We are the opposites! You say day and I say night, You say dark and I say bright, You say heavy and I say light, We are the opposites! 1. Listen and repeat. 3. Extend this poem by using the following opposite words. 2. Write the opposite words for the following words. near × far up × down in × out hot × cold big × small wet × dry (a) yes × no (b) night × __________ (c) fast × __________ (d) stop × __________ (e) dark × __________ (f) heavy × __________ Yes No For the Teacher : • Help the children to extend the poem by replacing the opposite words according to colour scheme. Do you know? • The poem ‘Everybody has a Name’. UNIT THREE
